title: KL Half Marathon 2026 Review: JomRun's 3:30 AM Flag-Off at Padang Merbok
seo_title: KL Half Marathon 2026 Review | JomRun Kuala Lumpur Race
meta_description: KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun: August 16 at Padang Merbok, KL. A 3:30 AM flag-off — one of Malaysia's earliest starts — with registration open.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at Padang Merbok in Kuala Lumpur, this JomRun-powered half marathon features a 3:30 AM flag-off — one of Malaysia's earliest race starts. Registration open.
verdict: The KL Half Marathon Powered by JomRun is notable for one thing above all: a 3:30 AM flag-off — one of the earliest starts in Malaysian road racing, designed to get runners through before KL's daytime heat peaks. Anchored at Padang Merbok (the city's ceremonial field near the Parliament), this JomRun-powered race offers standard distance options with the platform's familiar registration experience. Registration is open. For KL runners wanting a half marathon with an ultra-early start that means finishing before the sun gets serious, this is a practical pick.

sections.heading: 3:30 AM: Beating KL's Heat
paragraphs: The 3:30 AM flag-off is one of the earliest in Malaysian racing — a deliberate heat-management strategy that means finishing before mid-morning. [1] Padang Merbok is KL's ceremonial field near the Parliament, with wide roads and good event infrastructure. JomRun's platform handles registration.
